name: Family Visit Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must be a foreign citizen of Pakistani origin, or the foreign spouse of such a person, seeking to visit/stay with family in Pakistan.
Must provide marriage certificate, birth certificate, and POC/CNIC/NICOP documentation proving the family relationship.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain marriage/birth certificates and the sponsoring relative's POC, CNIC, or NICOP.

evidence_required.document: Sponsoring relative's POC, CNIC, or NICOP

outcome.duration_length: 5 years validity, up to 1 year stay per entry, multiple entries; annually renewable in-country

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Pakistan (mission page) -- Family Visit Visa: for foreign citizens of Pakistani origin and their spouses to visit and stay with family members; requires photo, passport, POC or equivalent, marriage certificate, birth certificate, CNIC/NICOP; up to 5 years validity with up to 1 year stay per entry, multiple entries; maximum fee USD 70 for the full 5-year period; annually renewable in Pakistan

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Pakistan). Published on a tier-1 government mission page (Ministry of Foreign Affairs). This is a VISIT/residence visa, not a citizenship grant -- it is what a foreign spouse of a Pakistani-origin person actually lives on day-to-day, distinct from pk_citizenship_by_marriage.json (Section 10(2) naturalisation, which the female spouse of this route can separately apply for after 5 years' aggregate residence). Gender-neutral on its face (covers 'spouses' generally, not restricted to one sex), unlike the citizenship-by-marriage route which is restricted to foreign women -- flagged as a notable internal inconsistency: a foreign husband of a Pakistani woman can hold this family visit visa indefinitely but historically could not convert it to citizenship the way a foreign wife of a Pakistani man could (see pk_citizenship_by_marriage.json notes on the 2024 Sindh High Court ruling).
